confidence interval for

pieces.text: The correlation coefficient,
, measures how close a set of data points is to being linear. In other words, it measures the strength of the linear correlation of the data set.
Larger values of
mean the data set has a stronger linear correlation. Smaller values of
mean the data set has a weaker linear correlation.
The correlation coefficient,
, is between -1 and 1. It is 1 if the data points are on a line with positive slope. It is -1 if the data points are on a line with negative slope.
